// === Tab: mySketch ===
let tile
let bevel
let font

async function setup() {
	createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight, WEBGL)
	font = await loadFont('https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/ebgaramond/v32/SlGDmQSNjdsmc35JDF1K5E55YMjF_7DPuGi-6_RUA4V-e6yHgQ.ttf')
	tile = createFramebuffer({ width: 200, height: 200, format: FLOAT })

	bevel = baseFilterShader().modify(() => {
		getColor((inputs, canvasContent) => {
			const s = 10
			let center = s * getTexture(canvasContent, inputs.texCoord).x
			let right = s * getTexture(canvasContent, inputs.texCoord + [1, 0]/inputs.canvasSize).x
			let bottom = s * getTexture(canvasContent, inputs.texCoord + [0, 1]/inputs.canvasSize).x
			const normal = normalize(cross([1, 0, bottom - center], [0, 1, right - center]))

			const ambient = [0.3, 0.35, 0.6]
			const specular = [0.4, 0.5, 0.6]
			const toLight = normalize([-1, -1, 1])
			let c = ambient + specular * max(0, dot(normal, toLight))
			c = mix(c, ambient, 0.2*noise(inputs.texCoord * 50))
			
			return vec4(c, 1)
		})
	})
}

function draw() {
	background(0)

	const t = millis()
	const blink = min(
		1 - sin(map(sin(t * 0.0005), -0.1, 0.1, 0, PI, true)),
		1 - sin(map(sin(t * 0.0007), -0.1, 0.1, 0, PI, true)),
	)

	tile.draw(() => {
		background(0)
		rectMode(CENTER)

		noStroke()
		
		
		fill(255/2)
		rect(0, -25, 100, 70)

		textFont(font)
		fill(255/2)
		textAlign(CENTER, CENTER)
		textSize(50)
		push()
		translate(0, 60)
		scale(1, 1.15)
		text('Mac OS', 0, 0)
		pop()

		push()
		translate(0, -25)
		stroke(255)
		strokeWeight(3)
		noFill()
		
		beginShape()
		bezierVertex(15, -45)
		bezierVertex(5, -40)
		bezierVertex(-10, -5)
		bezierVertex(-10, 5)
		vertex(5, 5)
		bezierVertex(5, 20)
		bezierVertex(10, 40)
		bezierVertex(20, 45)
		endShape()

		const h = 10 * blink
		line(-20, -15-h/2, -20, -15+h/2)
		line(20, -15-h/2, 20, -15+h/2)

		beginShape()
		bezierVertex(-25, 15)
		bezierVertex(-15, 25)
		bezierVertex(15, 25)
		bezierVertex(25, 15)
		endShape()
		pop()

		filter(BLUR, 1.5)
		filter(bevel)
	})
	
	textureWrap(REPEAT)
	texture(tile)
	noStroke()
	beginShape(QUAD_STRIP)
	vertex(-width/2, -height/2, 0, 0)
	vertex(width/2, -height/2, width, 0)
	vertex(-width/2, height/2, 0, height)
	vertex(width/2, height/2, width, height)
	endShape()
}
